constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (arena_id) REFERENCES clubs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.name: poker_diamond_custody_arena_id_fkey

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.name: poker_diamond_custody_user_id_fkey

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((seat_id IS NULL) AND (seat_joined_at IS NULL) AND (occupancy_id IS NULL)) OR ((purpose = 'cash_seat'::text) AND (seat_id IS NOT NULL) AND (seat_joined_at IS NOT NULL) AND (occupancy_id IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.name: poker_diamond_seat_identity_complete

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX poker_diamond_custody_seat ON public.poker_diamond_custody USING btree (seat_id) WHERE (seat_id IS NOT NULL)
indexes.name: poker_diamond_custody_seat

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX poker_diamond_custody_pkey ON public.poker_diamond_custody USING btree (id)
indexes.name: poker_diamond_custody_pkey

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX poker_diamond_custody_user_id_purpose_target_id_entry_key_key ON public.poker_diamond_custody USING btree (user_id, purpose, target_id, entry_key)
indexes.name: poker_diamond_custody_user_id_purpose_target_id_entry_key_key

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX poker_diamond_one_open_entry ON public.poker_diamond_custody USING btree (user_id, purpose, target_id) WHERE (state <> 'released'::text)
indexes.name: poker_diamond_one_open_entry

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX poker_diamond_custody_arena ON public.poker_diamond_custody USING btree (arena_id)
indexes.name: poker_diamond_custody_arena

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX poker_diamond_custody_user_state ON public.poker_diamond_custody USING btree (user_id, state)
indexes.name: poker_diamond_custody_user_state

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX poker_diamond_custody_occupancy ON public.poker_diamond_custody USING btree (occupancy_id) WHERE (occupancy_id IS NOT NULL)
indexes.name: poker_diamond_custody_occupancy
